auth.token_lifetime: OAuth returns stripe_user_id; calls use our platform secret key plus Stripe-Account header (no per-account expiring token)
auth.refresh: refresh_token returned once at connection, used to roll tokens; store it

access_requirements.app_review_or_marketplace_listing: Connect platform profile required; Stripe Apps marketplace listing optional (review). Docs: 'OAuth isn't recommended for new Connect platforms'; Connect Onboarding for Standard accounts preferred.
access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: Customer admin clicks Connect with Stripe, signs in, selects the account and approves read_only access. Alternative with no Connect: customer creates a restricted API key (read-only on Charges, Customers, Invoices, Subscriptions, Balance transactions, Payouts) and pastes it.
access_requirements.cost_to_us: $0 for read-only OAuth connections (Connect fees apply only to payments or accounts we create; UNVERIFIED)
access_requirements.time_to_approval: Immediate for OAuth read_only; Connect profile may require Stripe review (UNVERIFIED)

sandbox.how_to_get: Dashboard sandboxes / test mode; separate test client_id

rate_limits: Live 100 rps global, 25 rps per endpoint, Search 20 rps; reads capped at average 500 per transaction over rolling 30 days, minimum 10,000 reads per month per account; platform has separate allocation for connected accounts
incremental_sync: created[gte] filter and starting_after cursor; Events API (/v1/events) for changes; Data Pipeline for full export

unified_api_coverage.apideck: unverified (appears on connectors page; not confirmed as connector)

blockers: Read allocation (500 reads per transaction) can throttle large backfills; use Data Pipeline or incremental events.
OAuth is 'not recommended for new Connect platforms'; fall back to restricted-key paste if Connect profile blocks us.

existing in repo: ~/arthur/scripts/stripe-q.mjs, stripe-connect-check.mjs, ~/arthur/lib/stripe/client.js (direct secret key / restricted key for Dabney's own account; env names STRIPE_DABNEY_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_DABNEY_RESTRICTED_KEY). Not a multi-tenant OAuth path yet.
sources: https://docs.stripe.com/connect/oauth-standard-accounts - 'OAuth isn't recommended for new Connect platforms'; 'scope ... read_only being the default'; Stripe-Account header
https://docs.stripe.com/rate-limits - 'Live mode: 100 requests per second'; 'must not exceed an average of 500 per transaction'; 'minimum allocation of 10,000 read requests per month'
